ask: can u make a list of everything we gotta bring with 1 or 2 ppl on each thing
sentence: A shared bring list where group members tap an item to sign up to bring it, with up to two people per item and room to add more items.
use_when: A group needs to split up who brings what to a party, trip, or meetup
Each item needs one or two people to cover it
People want to see what is still open and sign up or drop with a tap
dont_use_when: The group needs to vote or pick between options
Costs need to be split or tracked between people
Tasks need due dates, assignments by a leader, or more than two people per item
